mentions.name: Reinforcement-learning game bot
mentions.description: A game bot built with a reinforcement learning approach for a turn-based game with a lot of hidden information. Inspired by the Pluto bot that won a major bot tournament, it aims to explore how far an RL bot can get on a much smaller budget than the tens of thousands of dollars reportedly spent on tournament-winning bots.
mentions.problem: Tournament-winning game bots appear to cost tens of thousands of dollars to build; this project tests how far a much smaller budget can go in a turn-based game with heavy hidden information.
mentions.source_excerpt: I always was fascinated by ai in games and seeing https://github.com/tscmoo/pluto win major bot tournament I wanted to try my hand at building one with RL approach. I am hoping that it won't cost too much as it seems they were able to do it for tens of thousand of dollars? I wanted to see how far I would get with much smaller budget but in a turn game with a lot of hidden information.
